- Whether the tracker actually sets a cookie — no cookie jar captured; the P0 rests on banner text + network log + privacy page text, not on cookie storage.

**Notes for the orchestrator:**
- `persona-evaluator/screenshots/01-scrolled.png` and `03-demo-form.png` are blank in this fixture; the testimonial and demo-form findings cite `session.log`/`findings-raw.json` only.
